17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans

4200 S. Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: B3-2 Community Shopping District
Lot Area: 15,112.5 sq. ft. (100.75' x 150.0")

PIN: 20-03-123-019

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant proposes to convert an existing one-story brick commercial
building, most recently occupied by a dry cleaning establishment, to a coin-operated laundromat
with an accessory amenity lounge for laundromat patrons. The property will operate as a single
establishment under one business license. No additions, no increase in building footprint, and
no increase in building height are proposed. All work consists of interior alteration and facade
repair within the existing structure. Fourteen (14) off-street parking spaces are proposed where
none currently exist. Coin-operated laundromat is specific use type NN.2 under the Use Table of
Sec. 17-3-0207 and is permitted by right in the B3 district. It is not allowed in the B1 or B2
districts, and B3 is therefore the least intensive business district in which the proposed use may
be established. The applicant will seek all relief needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning
Code, for the attached plans.

{A) The Project's Floor Area Ratio: 5,256 square feet (0.35 FAR)

(B) The Project's Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): Not applicable. The proposed
development contains zero (0) dwelling units. The property is and will remain in exclusively
non-residential use.

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 14 parking spaces, including one (1) accessible space

The proposed coin-operated laundromat falls within Parking Group N. Under
Off-Street Parking Schedule 1, Sec. 17-10-0207-N, a B district with a dash-2 suffix
requires no parking for the first 4,000 square feet of gross floor area and 1.66
spaces per 1,000 square feet thereafter. At 5,256 square feet, three (3) spaces are
required. Fourteen (14) spaces are proposed. Minimum bicycle parking required:
none.

D) Setbacks:

The existing building is located on the south and west lot lines. The B3-2 district imposes
setback requirements of 7’-0” front, 16’-0” rear, and 5’-0” combined side (with a minimum
of 2’-0” on either side). The existing building complies with the front, rear, and north side
requirements. However, the south side setback is 0’-0”, which does not meet the
required 2’-0” minimum.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-1101 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is
seeking a Variation to permit a reduction of the south side setback from the required
2’-0” to 0’-0” (existing condition). The structure was constructed prior to the current
zoning classification and occupies substantially the entire buildable area of the zoning
lot. As noted on the Plat of Survey, the building sits on the south lot line. The pre-existing
non-conforming setback cannot be corrected without demolition of the existing structure.
No change to the existing building envelope is proposed.

(E) Building Height: 17 feet (one story)
